create_omat24_static_vasp_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 PBE static calculation using OMat24StaticSet with a pymatgen Structure
create_omat24_relaxation_vasp_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 PBE relaxation calculation using OMat24RelaxSet with IBRION 2 and ISIF 3
create_omat24_aimd_vasp_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 AIMD simulation using OMat24AIMDSet with configurable temperature, ensemble, and thermostat
configure_omat24_aimd_thermostat: configure the OMat24AIMDSet thermostat to use nose or langevin with ensemble nvt or npt settings
review_omat24_incar_updates: review the OMat24RelaxSet and OMat24AIMDSet incar_updates property to inspect INCAR parameters for VASP calculations
